name: Storm
notes: Ororo Munroe grew up in north Africa, where she was worshiped as a goddess. She has a strength of will and self-confidence that sustains her, even in the face of great adversity. She feels a strong sisterhood with Jean Grey and is close to Logan and Kitty.

kit.name: Former Goddess
always: Goddess Powers: start with 4 Power Tokens. Spend for Advantage on a [⛆] skill, or to power a special effect.
Regain 3–4 Power Tokens when you commune with nature.

powers.name: Storm's Attic
powers.text: When in a place of natural power (like a storm) regain up to 4 Power Tokens. Your attic at the Xavier School counts as such a place.

powers.name: Puissance
powers.text: You may spend a Power Token to affect a large area (size of a US state) with your power.

powers.name: Sudden Squall
powers.effect: The target and each creature adjacent to you are pushed 3 squares.

powers.name: Ice Surface
powers.effect: If the target moves next turn, it must Save or fall Prone.

powers.name: Thunder Crack
powers.effect: Deal 2✸ with no attack roll. Counts as rolling a 5 for triggering abilities, e.g. Tactics.

powers.name: Weather Goddess
powers.effect: You may not use your [⛆]-marked Encounter powers until you have taken damage. Before rolling to attack, you may push yourself: take 2✸ and add +2✸ to the attack. For powers like Thunder Crack without a roll, you may push yourself to add a flat +1✸.

powers.name: Flyer
powers.effect: You may gain the Flying status as a Move Action. If you become Bloodied while Flying, you fall to the ground Prone.

powers.name: Storm Unleashed [⛆]
powers.effect: Create a 7x7 zone centered within R10. Each creature within the zone takes 3✸.

powers.name: Lightning Bolt [⛆]
powers.effect: If you roll 4/5, choose 1/2 of these effects. If you roll 6, choose 2 and +3✸: Immobilized (save ends) | 2✸ ongoing (save ends) | Panicked (one turn).

powers.name: Strong Willed
powers.effect: You may Rally twice per encounter. When you Rally, or are Healed, regain +1 HP. You succeed at Saving Throws on a roll of 3+.

role_actions.name: Tactics
role_actions.effect: One ally may Move. When you roll 3+ on attack, gain an additional use of this ability.

role_actions.name: Calming Advice
role_actions.effect: Target regains ½ max HP (round down), and may pick one: stand up if Prone; if at max HP gain Advantage on their next attack; enemies have Disadvantage to attack them until the end of their next turn; make a Saving Throw against a Status or attempt to escape a Grab.

role_actions.name: "Strike now!"
role_actions.effect: Target one enemy. All attacks against it have Advantage until the end of its next turn.

role_actions.name: Shrewd Advice
role_actions.effect: Trigger: When an ally makes any roll, spend one Action Point. They may reroll.

role_actions.name: Rally
role_actions.effect: Spend 1 Action Point: Heal 5 HP. Regain one Encounter power.
